bagPolicy.summary: There is currently no clear-bag requirement, but all backpacks and oversized bags are prohibited. Other bags are subject to a search or metal detector screening; no numeric size is specified.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The recommended University Garage at 145 Roosevelt Way costs $30 per car and opens two hours before the show; advance parking can be added to tickets.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Saenger Theatre. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Outside food and beverages and cans or bottles are prohibited; the operator links to a separate food and drink guide.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Service animals are welcome. Guests with disabilities, medical conditions or special needs should call (504) 525-1052 before the event to arrange reasonable accommodations, including exceptions to the prohibited items list.

reEntry.summary: The Saenger venue guide does not state a general concert re-entry rule.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office opens only on show days, starting two hours before showtime; it cannot sell tickets over the phone or sell other shows during an event.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: All patrons pass a walk-through metal detector and may have their bag searched. Allow extra arrival time; the box office opens two hours before showtime.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
